description: Defines the URLRequestFilter class, which manages URL request interceptors based on URL or hostname, including singleton access, adding/removing interceptors, and request interception logic.

classes.name: URLRequestFilter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages URL request interceptors based on URL or hostname, providing methods to add, remove, and clear interceptors, and to intercept requests.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of URLRequestFilter.

methods.name: AddHostnameInterceptor
methods.description: Adds an interceptor for requests matching a specific scheme and hostname.

methods.name: RemoveHostnameHandler
methods.description: Removes the interceptor associated with a specific scheme and hostname.

methods.name: AddUrlInterceptor
methods.description: Adds an interceptor for a specific URL.

methods.name: RemoveUrlHandler
methods.description: Removes the interceptor associated with a specific URL.

methods.name: ClearHandlers
methods.description: Clears all URL and hostname interceptors and resets hit count.

methods.name: hit_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times interceptors have been used.

methods.name: MaybeInterceptRequest
methods.description: Intercepts a URLRequest if a matching interceptor exists.
